description.zh: Shader 流：把 Shadertoy shader 在侧边栏 WebView 里实时渲染。带硬件测量页（WebGL context 上限与各画质档实测帧率）、接口契约探测页（在真实会话里实测数据接口）、缓存面板（占用 + 真实绝对路径 + 一键清理），以及**不联网的设备自测**（用内置假数据跑通整条流水线）。
description.en: Shader Feed: live Shadertoy rendering in a sidebar WebView, plus a hardware probe (WebGL context limit and per-quality-scale frame rates), an interface-contract discovery page for a live session, a cache panel (usage, real absolute path, one-tap clear), and an offline self-test that drives the whole pipeline with built-in fixtures.
description.default: Live Shadertoy rendering plus hardware, interface-contract, cache and offline self-test panels.
